maria_pmad: Quick sync: we need a compact plan for dashboards + trace hooks + cost breakdown. Customers ask for per-route cost and model-span traces.

sam_eng: Proposal: MVP = dashboard cards (per-route cost estimate + confidence) + sampled traces that tag model spans. Phase 2 = full-span stitching and export.

olivia_csm: Pilot customers: want per-route cost and top error traces. Exports are nice-to-have later.

jordan_infra: Sampling sketch: baseline 0.05%, error=100%, latency=5%, per-route overrides for Dedicated. Edge tags: model_name, model_version, route_id. Backend tail-sample to reduce storage.

lee_sre: Launch gates: dashboard p75 <1.5s; cost error <=20% on skewed workloads; trace-capture >95% of error types in pilot; fallback if ingest > threshold. Add e2e harness to validate per-route cost math.

maria_pmad: Action items: @sam_eng write RFC for sampling + quota by Wed; @jordan_infra edge tag spec + harness; @olivia_csm draft pilot comms. Pilot in 6 weeks, GA in 12 if gates pass.
